annotations.title: Google Ads seasonality adjustments (tell Smart Bidding about a sale or launch)

description: Seasonality adjustments tell Google’s Smart Bidding that conversion rate will move for a short event (a sale, a launch, a holiday weekend), so it bids for the event instead of learning it late. action "list" shows them; "create" needs name, start and end ("YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss", the end is exclusive, at most 14 days apart, and Google expects a future event), conversionRateModifier (0.1 to 10: 1.5 means 50% more conversions per click than usual, 0.8 means 20% fewer) and what it covers: campaignIds (up to 2,000 campaigns) OR channels (SEARCH, DISPLAY, SHOPPING, DEMAND_GEN), never both; optional devices. "update" changes the named fields of one (id); "remove" deletes one (id). It moves real bids on every campaign it covers, so create, update and remove need confirm:true after the user agrees; dryRun:true has Google validate it and changes nothing. Google’s API cannot create an account-wide adjustment and does not allow them on manager accounts. The reply is read back from Google. Free.

campaignIds.description: campaign ids it covers (up to 2,000); not together with channels

channels.description: every campaign of these channel types; not together with campaignIds

confirm.description: true after the user agreed to the dates, modifier and coverage (create, update, remove)

customerId.description: Google Ads account id, 10 digits (dashes ok); omit for the brand's default account

devices.description: limit it to these devices; omit for all

dryRun.description: true = validate with Google and change nothing

end.description: when it stops, "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss" (exclusive); at most 14 days after start

id.description: seasonality adjustment id (update, remove), from action list

includeRemoved.description: action list: also show removed ones

loginCustomerId.description: manager (MCC) account id, when the account is managed through one
